entry.title: When Everything Goes Wrong on a Family Road Trip… #SanDiego to #Redwoods

media:group.media:title: When Everything Goes Wrong on a Family Road Trip… #SanDiego to #Redwoods
media:group.media:description:
This trip tested everything.
What was supposed to be a simple RV adventure turned into chaos, things breaking, tensions rising, and me feeling like I had to hold it all together.
But somewhere between the frustration and the Redwoods, something shifted.
I was reminded this isn’t about fixing everything and if i truly try to fix everything i could never do it anyway. The best memories usually come wrapped in the hardest moments

media:group.media:description: I used to own an agency, my team and I wouldn’t only document my stories but we had clients as well. Unfortunately I lost everything. entry.title: From the Tree to the Rink – A Henry Family Christmas

media:group.media:title: From the Tree to the Rink – A Henry Family Christmas
media:group.media:description:
It’s our favorite time of year, the tree is up, the family is together, and the living room just turned into a full-on hockey rink. This Christmas, we surprised the kids with something special: NHL Puck Rush, exclusively on Nex Playground a motion-based game console that gets your whole family off the couch and into the game. No controllers, no wires just movement, laughter, and friendly competition. We love finding ways to connect as a family, and this right here? It’s more than a game. It’s memories in the making. Whether you're raising future athletes, trying to burn off that holiday energy, or just want a gift that gets everyone moving, Nex Playground is it. With games like NHL Puck Rush, Homerun Heroes, Tennis Smash, and more, it's the perfect way to turn screen time into family time.
